evidenceAudit.scope: Adult or child with suspected coeliac disease: who to test, immunoglobulin A (IgA) tissue transglutaminase (tTG) and total IgA, gluten intake before testing, biopsy referral, using NICE NG20.
findings: Every dose, threshold and timing was checked against the cited source section on 2026-10-18.
Normal values are typical adult reference ranges; laboratories differ.
unverifiedSections: Human leukocyte antigen (HLA) testing criteria in children and biopsy-free diagnosis thresholds were not captured.
Source pages were read through automated page extraction rather than page-by-page in the original documents, so each figure should be spot-checked against the source during clinical review.

pathophysiology.summary: IgA tTG with total IgA is the first-choice test; IgA endomysial antibody (EMA) is used if IgA tTG is weakly positive. Testing is accurate only on a gluten-containing diet: gluten at more than one meal daily for at least 6 weeks before testing. IgA deficiency is total IgA below 0.07 g per litre; IgG-based tests are considered only then. Biopsy is offered after an unambiguously positive IgA tTG or a weakly positive IgA tTG with positive IgA EMA.

clinicalManagement.title: Choose who to test
actions: Offer testing for persistent unexplained gastrointestinal symptoms, faltering growth, unexplained weight loss, type 1 diabetes, autoimmune thyroid disease and first-degree relatives; consider testing for bone, neurological, fertility, liver or dental features.

clinicalManagement.title: Confirm gluten intake
actions: Gluten at more than one meal daily for at least 6 weeks; do not start a gluten-free diet.

clinicalManagement.title: Send serology
actions: Total IgA and IgA tTG; IgA EMA if IgA tTG weakly positive.

clinicalManagement.title: Refer for biopsy
actions: Adults and young people: endoscopic biopsy; children: paediatric gastroenterologist.

medicationPlan.note: NICE NG20 does not mention drug treatment for coeliac disease; management is gluten-free diet, with calcium or vitamin D supplements if intake is insufficient.

diagnosticCriteria.threshold: More than one meal daily for at least 6 weeks.
Total IgA below 0.07 g per litre.
